summary: Ellington Financial Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to announce routine dividend declarations by its Board. No terms such as price per share, premium, or implied value are involved; the filing simply declares a monthly common dividend of $0.13 per share and quarterly preferred dividends on Series B, C, and D preferred stock with standard record and payment dates. This is an ordinary dividend announcement, not a special situation. No advisors, regulatory clocks, or structural complexities are noted. Filing is purely a standard disclosure of recurring dividends.
